Definition: to fuse (metal), i.e. refine (literally or figuratively)
BiblicalUsage: Tsaraph is the refiner's work — silver tried in a furnace until it is pure. The psalmist says the words of the LORD are pure words, as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times; Isaiah says God refined Israel in the furnace of affliction; and Zechariah promises that God will bring His people through the fire and refine them as silver is refined. The same word covers the goldsmith's craft and God's dealings with His people.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God refines His people the way a refiner refines silver — not to destroy them, but to purify them. My position is that the furnace of affliction is not God's abandonment; it is His attention, burning away what should not stay. I hold that what comes out of His fire is purer than what went in, and His word has already been proved pure.
